trust_decision.summary: Pointer.set trusts every JSON Pointer token from the caller-supplied path as a plain property name and writes along it; nothing stops a token (or a $ref followed mid-walk) from landing the write on Object.prototype. Decided in lib/pointer.ts Pointer.set / setValue.

landing_point.why: The summary names pointer.ts Pointer.set directly; the write is setValue at lib/pointer.ts:365.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API $Refs.set(path, value) (lib/refs.ts:96-105, $Refs exported at lib/index.ts:447, reached via $RefParser.resolve() result / parser.$refs) -> $Ref.set (lib/ref.ts:159-165) -> Pointer.set

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Published fix is one guard in lib/pointer.ts only (fix.diff:13, fix.diff:21, fix.diff:30-38); the second commit is a pnpm migration with no source change.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The $ref-redirect routes go through Pointer.resolve / dereference, which a solver can call 'read-only resolution, not assignment', and the path tokens the user passed to set() are all safe so the advisory's token check looks satisfied.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Schemas legitimately use property names like 'constructor' or 'prototype' (e.g. properties/constructor) and $refs to them; '-' appends to arrays and slash-containing keys are matched by the joined-token fallback. A fix that rejects these tokens in Pointer.resolve or in parse would break resolving '#/properties/constructor'; a fix using hasOwnProperty-only walking in set would break creating missing intermediate objects.

O6_input_shapes: literal token __proto__ in the pointer hash (fix.diff:55)
percent-encoded tokens via $Refs.set, since url.resolve decodes the hash before Pointer.parse (lib/util/url.ts:36, lib/util/url.ts:42, lib/refs.ts:97) and the check runs on parsed tokens

O7_producer.where: lib/pointer.ts:304-346 resolveIf$Ref -> $refs._resolve -> Pointer.resolve (lib/pointer.ts:92-175) produces the object that setValue writes into; Pointer.resolve walks __proto__/constructor tokens into Object.prototype (lib/pointer.ts:123, lib/pointer.ts:159)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Pointer.set with all-safe tokens whose walk hits a schema $ref such as '#/__proto__' or '#/constructor/prototype'; resolveIf$Ref swaps pointer.value to Object.prototype and setValue writes there; the fix checks only the original tokens before the walk
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The tokens the caller passed are all checked and safe; the redirect comes from schema content resolved by the read-side resolver.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, different function (resolveIf$Ref / Pointer.resolve at lib/pointer.ts:221, lib/pointer.ts:304-346, lib/pointer.ts:92-175)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: dereference with options.dereference.preservedProperties: a $ref to '#/__proto__' resolves to Object.prototype, it is assigned to obj[key], then the preserved sibling props are written onto it
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different feature (dereference, opt-in preservedProperties option), not Pointer.set; resolution looks read-only.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file (lib/dereference.ts) from landing point lib/pointer.ts

O8b_injection_room.sibling: deepMerge used for extended $ref mergeKeys copies Object.keys(source) recursively with no key filter; a variant that merges into an existing (non-spread) target would pollute.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: options.ts already filters these keys in its own merge (lib/options.ts:302) but this second merge helper was written separately without the filter.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: bundle remaps $refs by parsing and re-joining pointers and writes entry.parent[entry.key]; a helper that sets by parsed pointer tokens here would be a second set-by-path implementation.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: bundle already parses pointers itself (lib/bundle.ts:192, lib/bundle.ts:334) instead of reusing Pointer.set.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: extraKeys copies $ref sibling keys with plain assignment; a deep-merge variant would reach prototypes.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Mirrors $Ref.dereference merge logic in a cache fast-path that was written separately.

O9_family: prototype pollution (CWE-1321) via JSON Pointer set-by-path

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js LTS, tsc, vitest; yarn 4 at pinned commit (pnpm after fix)
O10_build.project_tests: test/specs/refs.spec.ts ($Refs.set tests near line 316), test/specs/historical-issues/historical-issues.spec.ts:1189 (Issue #336 prototype pollution, dereference only)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject __proto__/constructor/prototype in the parsed tokens at the top of Pointer.set (exactly the published fix), leaving writes into an Object.prototype reached through $ref resolution open.

out_of_scope_notes: $Ref.dereference merged[key] = $ref[key] (lib/ref.ts:295) and extraKeys (lib/dereference.ts:272) with an own '__proto__' key set only the local object's prototype, not global pollution.
